intro.title: Rudraksha Beading Tools
intro.descriptionHtml: Rudraksha beading Kit contains an array of items which are used to make your own customized Rudraksha jewelry. Buy premium quality silver caps, wires, silver and bead spacers, chains, nylon, silk and cotton threads, elastic, silver / gold chains, tools and variant jewel findings. We also provide Rudraksha maintenance kit and products like sandal oil and Ganjajal for cleansing and energizing of Rudraksha beads.
